gloss_en: Revit 2022 IFC exporter drops shaft openings that share an edge with floors; floor boundary wrong.
title_original: Problem: Bug Revit 2022 IFC Export Shaft opening in floors
question_paraphrase: Shaft openings sharing an edge with floors are missing or the floor boundary is wrong in the IFC; confirmed by others up to Revit 2024.
phrasing_notes: numbered repro steps; later commenters just add 'still a problem in version X'
answer_summary: Open bug, no fix; workaround is to model openings differently and check geometry after export.

gloss_en: Beam joined to wall with identical top elevation: no IfcOpeningElement is created, solids overlap (regression vs Revit 2025).
title_original: PR: IFC export skips opening cut when intersecting element is flush with wall top
question_paraphrase: Wall exported uncut with no IfcOpeningElement/IfcRelVoidsElement when beam top equals wall top; 1 mm offset fixes it.
phrasing_notes: very structured; German Revit build noted (DEU)
answer_summary: Open bug; workaround is offsetting elevation by 1 mm.

gloss_en: After updating the IFC exporter, IfcSpaces are shifted out of the building and room heights are wrong in 3 models.
title_original: PR: Room geometry shifted in IFC Exporter 25.4.40.17 + 25.4.41.5 + 26.4.0.16 + 26.4.0.32
question_paraphrase: Spaces moved outside the building and wrong heights after exporter update; only 26.1.0.23 avoids shifting.
answer_summary: Regression in specific exporter builds; roll back to an older build.

gloss_en: With shared coordinates, rooms are exported high above the geometry by the project elevation.
title_original: PR: Rooms exported with wrong elevation with shared coordinates
question_paraphrase: IfcSpaces are offset by project elevation when exporting with shared coordinates; resetting coordinates to zero aligns them.
answer_summary: Open bug; avoid project elevation or fix after export.

gloss_en: Building exported with shared coordinates and site with survey point leads to double rotation by True North.
title_original: Building with shared coordinates rotated twice on the site
question_paraphrase: Site IFC and building IFC each carry the True North rotation, so the combined model is rotated twice.
phrasing_notes: long structured explanation of coordinate base choices
answer_summary: Choose a consistent coordinate base across models.

gloss_en: Prerelease exporter 2022.5.2 exports floor openings incorrectly in the IFC2x3 Coordination View.
title_original: Openings in floors
question_paraphrase: Floor openings broken with the new exporter version in the 2x3 Coordination View; screenshots compare 2022.5.1 and 2022.5.2.
answer_summary: Version regression; use previous exporter.

gloss_en: 23 walls get a random IFC GUID on every export which breaks the database linkage.
title_original: Random IFC GUID for walls at each export
question_paraphrase: GUIDs of some walls change on every export; reporter traced it to CreateAlternateGUID collisions.
answer_summary: GUID collision falls back to random GUID.

gloss_en: GUIDs of steel connections and parametric cuts change on each export.
title_original: IFC GUID changes Revit 2019
question_paraphrase: Elements from the Steel tab get new GUIDs at export, with zip example.
answer_summary: Known GUID instability.

gloss_en: Slab mapped to IfcSite works only unmodified; with modified points the class is wrong.
title_original: Revit Slab to IfcSite does not work with modified points
question_paraphrase: Topography via slab to IfcSite fails when slab points were edited.
answer_summary: Open issue.

gloss_en: In Germany several Revit levels per storey are used (finished floor, slab top); asks to map all of them to one IfcBuildingStorey.
title_original: ENH: Export multiple levels as one IfcBuildingStorey
question_paraphrase: IfcSpatialContainer parameter should work on a level so elements of FFL and slab-top levels land in one storey.
phrasing_notes: explicit German practice, rhetorical 'why should it be so hard'
answer_summary: Currently per-element IfcSpatialContainer or scripting; a commenter rebuilds the spatial hierarchy in a separate IFC.

gloss_en: Wants to use Assembly Code for national classification without Uniformat being exported.
title_original: ENH: Disable Uniformat classification if Assembly Code parameter is used for other classification system
question_paraphrase: Uniformat is irrelevant outside the US; Assembly Code with a custom classification file is best UX.
answer_summary: Feature request.

gloss_en: Own office-wide LoadBearing parameter (German name Tragwerk) cannot override Pset_WallCommon.LoadBearing via mapping file.
title_original: PR: Can't overwrite *_Common.LoadBearing with a user defined parameter
question_paraphrase: Mapping lines for Pset_WallCommon LoadBearing have no effect; works for other common properties.
answer_summary: Built-in parameter wins on name clash.

gloss_en: Width (thickness) base quantity missing for walls exported as IfcCovering.
title_original: PR: Widht in CoveringBaseQuantitie from basicwall is missing
question_paraphrase: Qto_CoveringBaseQuantities lacks Width for basic walls mapped to IfcCovering/USERDEFINED.
answer_summary: Open bug.

gloss_en: Run IDS checks inside Revit before the slow IFC export.
title_original: ENH: IDS auditing
question_paraphrase: Wishes IDS auditing on Revit parameters pre-export to avoid double checking.
answer_summary: Feature idea.

gloss_en: Beam length/width/height mixed up in IfcRectangleProfileDef/extrusion depending on IFC version.
title_original: PR: Beam export IfcRectangleProfileDef, ExtrudedSolid dimensions not as expected
question_paraphrase: Profile XDim/YDim and extrusion depth do not match L/W/H expectations; differs between 2x3, 4 DTV and 4x3.
answer_summary: Open bug.

gloss_en: How to link georeferenced IFC files in Revit 2022 so they sit in the right position; works in Trimble/BIM Vision.
title_original: IFC to Revit (shared coordinates)
question_paraphrase: Linking IFC with shared coordinates into Revit misplaces models though viewers show them correctly.
answer_summary: Not resolved in the portion read.

gloss_en: IFC import: windows sit outside the wall face in 3D (not in Revit 2024).
title_original: PR: When importing IFC files, windows are positioned outside the wall face in the 3D view
question_paraphrase: Windows from an Archicad IFC are offset out of walls in Revit 2025-27.
answer_summary: Regression.

gloss_en: Floors do not export even though mapped to IfcSlab; invalid class elsewhere falls back to proxy.
title_original: PR: Floors not exporting
question_paraphrase: Floors silently skipped while other categories fall back to IfcBuildingElementProxy.
answer_summary: Open bug.

gloss_en: Hundreds of auto-generated IfcBuildingElementProxyTypes from curtain wall profiles cannot be given IfcExportAs.
title_original: PR: auto-generated building element proxy type
question_paraphrase: Revit generates one proxy type per element; no editable Revit type, so clients see empty proxies.
answer_summary: Open.

gloss_en: Fascias and wall sweeps stay IfcBuildingElementProxy despite mapping and IfcExportAs.
title_original: Fascias and Wall Sweeps not able to override IFC Class from BuildingElementProxy
question_paraphrase: Tried IFC options and IfcExportAs, still proxy.
answer_summary: Sub-elements follow host; limitation.

gloss_en: User shared parameters with same names as built-ins (Czech names) are replaced by built-in values in property sets.
title_original: PR: IFC export ignores mapping table setting for certain built-in parameters
question_paraphrase: Case-insensitive name clash overwrites user Volume/Area parameters with built-in ones.
answer_summary: Tracked internally by Autodesk.

gloss_en: IFC4 export of curtain walls crashes with AccessViolationException.
title_original: PR: IFC4 export of curtain walls crashes with AccessViolationException in FootPrintInfo
question_paraphrase: Export crash on curtain walls.

gloss_en: Joined-geometry walls with mass exported wrongly in Revit 2026.
title_original: PR: Revit 2026 export joined geometry walls with mass
question_paraphrase: Joined walls and mass geometry break at export.
answer_summary: Title only seen in search results; answer not read.

gloss_en: BIM Deutschland explains the CDE per ISO 19650 and says an open CDE must manage IFC, BCF, COBie.
title_original: Common Data Environment
question_paraphrase: Official explanation of CDE states WIP/Shared/Published/Archive and openBIM.
answer_summary: CDE uses ISO 19650 states; open formats IFC, BCF, COBie.

gloss_en: Explains MVDs (Coordination View, Design Transfer View, Reference View, QTO View) and that AIA/BAP must name them.
title_original: Model View Definitions
question_paraphrase: MVD defines which data an IFC must contain for an exchange use case.
answer_summary: MVDs must be fixed in AIA and BAP.

gloss_en: Download list of Muster-AIA, Muster-BAP and BIM4INFRA2020 Teil 9 Datenaustausch mit IFC.
title_original: BIM Deutschland Downloads
question_paraphrase: Federal AIA and BAP templates for Hochbau, Strasse, Schiene plus IFC data-exchange guide.
answer_summary: Templates are recommendations to be agreed project-specifically.

gloss_en: FAQ: are BIM-Portal requirements binding nationwide? Which formats do machine-readable AIA use (ifcXML)?
title_original: Welche Dateiformate bzw. Standards werden bei den maschinenlesbaren AIA verwendet?
question_paraphrase: BIM-Portal requirements are recommendations; agree per project; REST API for AIA contents.
answer_summary: Recommendations, binding only if introduced by responsible bodies.

gloss_en: BIMpedia article 'Öffnung, Durchbruch, Schlitz' in category Rohbau (seen via homepage link only).
title_original: Öffnung, Durchbruch, Schlitz
question_paraphrase: Article on openings/penetrations/slots; content not read.
answer_summary: Not read.

gloss_en: List all openings in walls from the architect model that have no matching MEP penetration.
prompt: zeig mir alle Wanddurchbrüche im Arch-Modell, wo keine TGA-Leitung durchgeht. brauch ich für die Durchbruchsplanung morgen
expected_behavior: Find IfcOpeningElement in walls, intersect with MEP element geometry from the linked model, list openings without crossing element with ids, storey, size.

gloss_en: Count proxies and their Revit categories.
prompt: wieviele IfcBuildingElementProxy sind in dem Export und aus welchen Revit-Kategorien kommen die? Mapping stimmt irgendwie nicht
expected_behavior: Count IfcBuildingElementProxy, group by category/ObjectType, suggest mapping table fixes.

gloss_en: Check where the project base point and the site are located and whether rotation is correct.
prompt: wo sitzt der Projektbasispunkt in der IFC und stimmt die Nordrichtung? Fachmodelle passen nicht übereinander
expected_behavior: Read IfcMapConversion, IfcProjectedCRS, IfcSite reference lat/long, placements; report offsets and true north, compare across files.

gloss_en: Check that all walls have LoadBearing, FireRating and IsExternal filled in.
prompt: prüf mal ob bei allen Wänden Tragend, Feuerwiderstand und Außenwand befüllt sind, sonst fliegen wir beim AIA-Check raus
expected_behavior: List walls missing Pset_WallCommon.LoadBearing, FireRating, IsExternal with GUIDs and counts.

gloss_en: Why do my shared parameters not appear in the IFC.
prompt: meine eigenen Parameter kommen in der IFC nicht an obwohl Häkchen bei benutzerdefinierte Psets gesetzt ist, woran liegts
expected_behavior: Explain mapping txt file format, name clashes with built-ins, type vs instance parameters, how to verify.

gloss_en: Move elements from slab-top levels to the finished-floor storeys.
prompt: Elemente auf OKRD-Ebenen bitte dem jeweiligen OKFF-Geschoss zuordnen, wir haben pro Geschoss zwei Ebenen
expected_behavior: Reassign IfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure to the intended IfcBuildingStorey; report moved counts; do not duplicate storeys.

gloss_en: Export wall areas and volumes per storey for tendering.
prompt: Wandflächen und Volumen je Geschoss als Liste fürs LV, nur Außenwände. werden Öffnungen abgezogen? bitte angeben
expected_behavior: Read Qto_WallBaseQuantities NetSideArea/GrossSideArea, group by storey, filter external, state openings treatment.

gloss_en: Compare two IFC exports and say what changed, GUIDs may have changed.
prompt: vergleich mal Stand 12 und Stand 14 vom Rohbau-IFC. was ist neu, was weg, was verschoben? GUIDs ändern sich bei uns teilweise
expected_behavior: Diff by GUID, fall back to geometry/name matching, report added/removed/moved.

gloss_en: List all ducts larger than 300 mm passing through fire walls.
prompt: welche Lüftungskanäle > 300 mm durchdringen F90 Wände? mit Geschoss und Position
expected_behavior: Find ducts, intersect with walls whose FireRating is F90, list size, storey, location.

gloss_en: Difference between Reference View and Design Transfer View, and which for exchange with the MEP planner.
prompt: was ist der Unterschied zwischen Reference View und Design Transfer View? welche nimmt man fürs Austauschen mit dem TGA Planer
expected_behavior: Explain MVDs, recommend according to purpose, note AIA/BAP should state it.

gloss_en: Check against an IDS file.
prompt: prüf die IFC gegen unsere IDS vom Auftraggeber und gib mir die Fehler nach Bauteilen
expected_behavior: Run IDS validation, group failures by requirement and entity, provide GUID lists.

gloss_en: Reclassify proxies that are really columns.
prompt: die Stützen sind alle als Proxy drin, kannst du die zu IfcColumn machen? Name fängt mit ST_ an
expected_behavior: Find proxies with matching name, change class to IfcColumn, preserve psets, report changes.

gloss_en: Why are floor openings missing after export.
prompt: Deckendurchbrüche fehlen in der IFC, in Revit sind sie da (Schacht). Export 2x3 CV. was tun?
expected_behavior: Explain shaft openings sharing edges may not export, suggest alternative modelling, verify after export.

gloss_en: List all rooms with area and usage for FM handover.
prompt: Raumliste mit Nutzung und Fläche für die FM-Übergabe, Räume ohne Namen markieren
expected_behavior: List IfcSpace with Name, LongName, area from Qto_SpaceBaseQuantities, flag unnamed.

gloss_en: Create BCF for missing wall penetrations.
prompt: mach mir aus den Kollisionen Rohr/Wand ein BCF mit Position und Bauteil-GUID, Durchbruch fehlt
expected_behavior: Compute pipe-wall intersections lacking openings, produce BCF issues with viewpoint and GUIDs.

gloss_en: Check units and coordinates; model appears kilometres away.
prompt: Modell liegt weit weg vom Ursprung, Einheiten mm oder m? check bitte
expected_behavior: Report IfcUnitAssignment, bounding box, placement offsets, probable cause and fix.
